evidence.field: Summary; Licensing; File history; Original file link
evidence.text: Commons identifies 休-seal.svg as a modern vector depiction of 休 in Shuowen seal-script style, sourced from Sinica Database, Chinese Etymology, CUHK Humanum, Chinese Text Project and Chinese Linguipedia. Its file history records creation/upload on 8 July 2016; this is not the date of the script form. Commons labels the representation public domain and says attribution is appreciated but not required. Its inspected original-file link resolves to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b4/%E4%BC%91-seal.svg (the browser could not render the SVG).
evidence.title: File:休-seal.svg — Wikimedia Commons

evidence.source: CUHK Humanum 漢語多功能字庫
evidence.field: 形義通解; early forms and graph analysis
evidence.text: The entry analyzes early 休 as 人 plus 木 and interprets it as a person resting in a tree’s shade; it notes that a competing graph analysis exists in the consulted sources. This interpretation supports using a seal-style 休 illustration as a later graphic example, but the illustration does not establish the disputed original motivation.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 休

items.caption: Modern redraw of 休 in Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates a later script form; the character’s original graph interpretation remains disputed.

This offers a sourced later-form example while making clear that it is a modern redraw and cannot settle the disputed original analysis.
